primary_objective.description: Land the rocket at coordinates (0,0) with minimal velocity and fuel consumption.
constraints: Avoid crashing into the moon surface (game_over)
Ensure lander remains awake in physics engine

phase_objectives.goal: Correct angle and reduce horizontal velocity using side engines.
Reduce vertical velocity while moving towards pad X=0.
Legs contact ground at low velocity.

behaviors_that_may_be_good_temporarily_b: High fuel consumption during initial stabilization
Oscillating near pad without landing to minimize velocity penalty
behaviors_that_should_not_be_overpenaliz: Fuel usage while correcting orientation from random start state
Small X deviations while prioritizing Y descent

proxy_metrics.name: immediate_reward
proxy_metrics.description: Return value from compute_reward function, used for gradient signal.
proxy_metrics.limitations: May not capture long-term success if sparse or poorly shaped.

diagnostic_metrics.name: leg_contact_status
diagnostic_metrics.interpretation: 1.0 indicates ground contact, must be verified with velocity for success.

diagnostic_metrics.name: terminal_velocity
diagnostic_metrics.interpretation: High values indicate crash or failed landing.

success_like_terminal.role: behavioral diagnostic, not official ground truth unless explicitly provided

passive_policy.description: Agent does nothing to minimize fuel cost, drifting until timeout or bounds.
passive_policy.detection: Low action frequency, high step count without termination.

wrong_action_mode_policy.description: Using side engines exclusively for propulsion instead of main engine.
wrong_action_mode_policy.detection: High s_power usage with minimal descent progress.

hovering_or_stalling.description: Maintaining altitude near ground to avoid crash penalty without landing.
hovering_or_stalling.detection: state[1] stable near 0, state[6/7] == 0, high fuel usage over time.

unstable_fast_completion.description: Crashing intentionally if crash penalty is lower than fuel cost of hovering.
unstable_fast_completion.detection: High velocity at termination with negative reward accumulation.

proxy_contact_or_terminal_behavior.description: Triggering leg contact sensors via collision rather than controlled landing.

proxy_reward_hacking.definition: Maximizing immediate reward signal without achieving the true objective (landing).
proxy_reward_hacking.example: Oscillating near pad to gain proximity rewards without touching down.

terminal_hacking.definition: Triggering termination conditions early to stop negative cumulative rewards.
terminal_hacking.example: Flying off-screen if out-of-bounds penalty is less than fuel cost of hovering.

hovering_hacking.definition: Exploiting lack of step limit or time penalty to stay airborne indefinitely.
hovering_hacking.example: Maintaining hover at safe altitude with minimal thrust.

component_dominance_hacking.definition: Optimizing one metric (e.g., position) while ignoring others (e.g., velocity).
component_dominance_hacking.example: Landing on pad but crashing due to high vertical velocity.

preferred_design: Sparse large reward for successful landing.
Dense negative penalty for fuel usage.
initial_reward_guidance: Ensure crash penalty is significantly higher than max possible fuel cost of hovering.
Normalize state values before applying thresholds in reward function.
